thesis: NuScale Power is the developer of the NuScale Power Module (NPM), a 77 MWe light-water small modular reactor and the only SMR design to receive U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission design certification, giving it a multi-year regulatory head start over rivals. Deployment now runs through ENTRA1 Energy, its exclusive global partner to develop, own and operate NuScale plants, with the RoPower six-module project in Romania and a growing U.S. data-center pipeline as the near-term commercialization test. The company ended Q1 2026 with roughly $1.0B in cash and essentially no debt, funding the plan for years, but revenue is tiny and declining (~$31.5M in FY2025), losses are large, and the RoPower final investment decision has slipped to late 2026. At $9.01 the stock trades far below the ~$14.57 consensus target but the outcome is binary and execution-dependent.

drivers: RoPower six-module Romania project reaches a positive final investment decision and moves toward construction
ENTRA1 Energy converts its pipeline into firm, financeable U.S. and international orders, including AI data-center off-takers
NRC standard design approval for the uprated 77 MWe NuScale Power Module clears, cementing the regulatory lead
Structural AI and data-center power demand accelerates SMR procurement and policy support
Only NRC-certified SMR design status translates into first-mover deployment and re-rating toward the ~$25 street high

risks: RoPower FID slips again and no binding, revenue-generating orders materialize
Continued heavy cash burn forces dilutive equity raises
Cost overruns and supply-chain or fuel constraints delay first commercial deployment
Nuclear-sector profit-taking and a 2.25 beta drive the stock below its $7.21 52-week low
Competing SMR and advanced-reactor designs erode NuScale's first-mover advantage

base_case.assumptions: RoPower advances toward FID with modest slippage and ENTRA1 signs initial firm orders while NuScale's ~$1.0B cash funds operations without near-term forced dilution; revenue stays small near-term but the NRC-certified design underpins a multi-year commercialization ramp. Stock trades toward the ~$14.57 consensus (18-analyst Hold) target, roughly 60% above current levels.

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — revenue, liquidity/cash runway, ENTRA1 pipeline and RoPower FID timing updates
RoPower (Romania) six-module VOYGR plant final investment decision — key commercialization milestone
NRC standard design approval for the uprated 77 MWe NuScale Power Module
ENTRA1 Energy conversion of pipeline into firm U.S. data-center and international orders
U.S. Department of Energy nuclear financing and policy support for SMR deployment

key_risks: Pre-commercial with tiny, declining revenue (~$31.5M FY2025) and large net losses; profitability years away
RoPower final investment decision has slipped to late 2026 and no binding commercial plant orders are yet secured
Heavy cash burn could require dilutive capital raises despite ~$1.0B liquidity
Extreme volatility and sentiment risk — beta 2.25, stock has fallen from a $57.42 52-week high toward $7.21
Intensifying competition from other SMR and advanced-reactor developers (BWXT, X-energy, Oklo, TerraPower)
